newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish bond, equity turnover slips in June - ISE.
newsitem.headline: Irish bond, equity turnover slips in June - ISE.

text.p: Turnover on the official list of the Irish Stock Exchange slipped to 1.72 billion Irish pounds in June from 1.79 billion in May, official figures showed on Tuesday.
Turnover in Irish government bonds also fell back, to 8.94 billion from 11.99 billion.
The market capitalisation of the official list rose to 28.19 billion at June 30, 1997 from 26.70 billion at end-May and 20.49 billion at the end of 1996.
